title: Embedding & Rerank: Endpoint Health and Cost Runbook (SLO + Alerts)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Provide an operator-friendly runbook and instrumentation changes to surface health, latency, quality drift, and cost for embeddings + reranking endpoints at the endpoint/pipeline level. Deliverables: 1) per-endpoint health dashboards (latency P50/P95/P99, token counts, batch sizes), 2) tracing spans that tie client request -> embed -> index fetch -> rerank model -> response, 3) cost attribution sliceable by endpoint+model variant, 4) alert rules and oncall runbook for common failure modes, 5) synthetic SLO checks and post-deploy smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards: Each active embeddings and rerank endpoint has a dedicated dashboard template with latency, throughput, token cost, model variant, and error breakdowns
Tracing: End-to-end trace captures embed and rerank sub-spans with unique request_id and sampling policy for traffic > 0.1% and full traces for synthetic tests
Cost: Per-request cost metric emitted and aggregated by endpoint and model variant; example chargeback report generated for past 7 days
Alerts: SLO-based alerts (P95 latency breach, error rate increase) with documented thresholds and oncall runbook steps
Synthetic: Daily synthetic cohort runs that exercise canonical embed->rerank flows and surface quality regressions (precision@k) and latency
Rollout: Migration guide for enabling new telemetry with no-more-than-1% tail latency impact on p99 during rollout
tasks: Instrument embed-service to emit 'embedding.request' metrics (tokens_in, tokens_out, batch_size, model_variant)
Add rerank-service spans with scorer timing and cache-miss tags
Create Grafana dashboard template + Grafana provisioning for each endpoint namespace
Implement per-request cost calculation in ingress proxy and emit 'request.unit_cost' metric
Define SLOs and alert thresholds with SRE and product stakeholders
Author oncall runbook with triage steps, mitigation commands, and rollback play
Build synthetic test harness and schedule daily cohort runs (compare against baseline)
Run canary rollout for telemetry changes against 5% traffic and monitor p99 impact

2026-03-11 - Design feedback from Priya Rao: Dashboard layout should surface quality metrics (precision@1, mean reciprocal rank) next to latency for rapid triage
2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Ran synthetic cohort and observed a 12% drop in precision@1 for variant 'rerank-v2' in cohort B — opened ENG-204820 for root cause investigation
decisions: Trace sampling: use adaptive sampling with guaranteed retention for synthetic tests and 0.1% tail sampling for production traffic
Cost calculation: compute unit cost at ingress using model-token-cost table and emit per-request metric rather than retrofitting from aggregate billing
Dashboarding: provide a reusable Grafana template that teams can instantiate per endpoint namespace rather than one-off dashboards
Alerting: tiered alerts — P0 for p99 latency spikes >300ms over baseline, P1 for sustained P95 breaches, P2 for small error rate upticks
